best_configuration: configs/gpu_improved_3ep.yaml — compat head (no inter-candidate attention) + LoRA(r=8) on last 4 of 12 kept Qwen3 layers + learned per-task temperature, 3 epochs
training: 20,000 real questions from avbiswas/bev-decision-150K ('all'), 3 epochs, micro-batch 8 x grad-accum 4 (32 q/step), bf16, 1,875 optimizer steps, ~55 min on RTX 5060, peak VRAM 3.3 GB
evaluation: held-out test split of the same dataset (n=2,280 questions), never used for training or model selection

seed_variance_3_seeds_1_epoch.note: worst compat run beats best reference run; the compat head is ~23x more seed-stable. This supersedes the single-seed caveat about the margin shrinking with training.

controlled_comparison_same_epochs_3.delta: +0.019 accuracy, -0.033 NLL, +0.022 choice, +0.020 noul, +0.004 score, +0.032 AUC, 28x lower order sensitivity
controlled_comparison_same_epochs_3.honest_note: these 3-epoch runs are single-seed; the 3-seed study above (at 1 epoch) shows the reference head is ~23x noisier across seeds, so treat the 3-epoch delta as an estimate rather than a tight bound

epoch_scaling.decision: 3 epochs is the default: best raw NLL (0.874) and ECE (0.048). 5 epochs buys +0.014 accuracy but needs a 1.95 temperature to be calibrated. 5-epoch checkpoint available for accuracy-first use.

vs_baselines_same_test_split.verdict: trained model beats every baseline on accuracy and NLL, and exceeds zero-shot full-model generation (0.52) while emitting zero tokens per decision

known_limitations: macro-F1 0.544 still trails accuracy 0.600: many-way choice remains the hard case
auc_noul 0.743 is well above chance but far from solved
3-epoch comparison is single-seed; only the 1-epoch comparison has a 3-seed variance study
GPU runs require WSL2 because this host's application-control policy blocks CUDA PyTorch on Windows
